in_marathi.name: Aksh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aksh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘aksh’, meaning ‘radiant’, ‘shining’, or ‘eye’. In Hindu mythology, Aksh is also the name of a sage and a deity associated with vision and wisdom.
